Rita Gomez: Quick owner-lock for the ledger variance postmortem. Root cause: delayed token ingest -> burst replay -> invoice deltas. Need owners+ETAs for: patch, backfill run, invoice tagging/corrections, credit policy, short recurrence scan. Reply with owner + ETA.

Samir Khatri: I'll own the consumer patch. Found retry amplification on DB writes. Plan: capped retries + jitter + DLQ. Canary tomorrow AM, prod rollout Fri 18:00 UTC.

Jade Park: I'll own the backfill execution and runbook. Will run a staging dry-run on 10 accounts tonight and provide a reconciled CSV. Prod backfill Saturday 02:00-05:00 UTC. Will include rollback steps.

CS Lead: I'll draft customer notifications and credit guidance. Proposal: auto-apply credits when corrected delta > $100, otherwise queue to CS for manual review; enterprise gets full credit. ETA: templates Fri 09:00 UTC.

Samir Khatri: Added alert metric metering.ingest.backlog.p95 > 800ms, hooked to eng-oncall. PR 701.

finance-bot: Incident logged MET-2025-03-28; ticket TKT-6217 created; linked PRs 701. Backfill window Sat 02:00-05:00 UTC.

Rita Gomez: Finance request: tag corrected invoices with memo "ledger-variance TKT-6217" and add a line item "metering adjustment". Include original invoice ID and corrected amount in the CSV.

Jade Park: Dry-run complete, CSV uploaded to the ticket. Sample reconciliations match expected deltas. Ready for prod window.

Samir Khatri: Canary passed. Will monitor during backfill and stand by for rollback.

CS Lead: Received CSV. I'll finalize templates and the credit matrix after the backfill. Will coordinate CS outreach for accounts > $500/mo.

Rita Gomez: Owners & ETAs recap:
- Consumer patch: Samir 1 canary tomorrow AM; rollout Fri 18:00 UTC
- Backfill & runbook: Jade 1 dry-run done; prod Sat 02:00 UTC
- Invoice tagging & corrections: Finance + Jade 1 corrections post-backfill Sat morning
- Credit policy & templates: CS Lead 1 templates Fri 09:00 UTC
- Short recurrence scan (30 days): Samir 1 chart by EOD

Rita Gomez: If anything slips, call it out here. Will mark these as assigned in the postmortem and close when corrections + 14-day audit finish. :white_check_mark:
